opportunities.title: AIML Research Internship — PES Institute of Technology
opportunities.description: 3-month summer internship in the AI/ML research lab. Work on computer vision and NLP projects under faculty guidance. Open to CSE/ECE B.Tech and M.Tech students.

opportunities.title: Google Summer of Code 2026 — Open Source AI Projects
opportunities.description: Contribute to open-source AI projects under Google mentorship. PESU has historically had 5–8 students selected every year.

opportunities.title: Microsoft Engage Mentorship Program
opportunities.description: 5-week mentorship program pairing students with Microsoft engineers. Culminates in a collaborative project showcase.

opportunities.title: Robotics Club — Autonomous Drone Project
opportunities.description: Join the PES Robotics Club to build an autonomous obstacle-avoidance drone for the national inter-college competition in August.

opportunities.title: IEEE Student Chapter — Technical Paper Presentation
opportunities.description: Present a technical paper at the PESU IEEE Student Chapter symposium. Winners receive cash prizes and fast-track to the national IEEE conference.

opportunities.title: Internship — Infosys Springboard AI Track
opportunities.description: Competitive AI-track internship at Infosys for pre-final year students. Selected interns receive a Pre-Placement Offer (PPO) based on performance.

opportunities.title: Faculty Research Collaboration — NLP & Multilingual AI
opportunities.description: Open collaboration for faculty and research scholars on multilingual NLP systems for Indian languages. Opportunity to publish at EMNLP or ACL.

opportunities.title: Hackathon — Smart India Hackathon 2026
opportunities.description: National-level government hackathon. PESU will send 5 teams this year. Students can apply as teams of 6. Wide scope — healthcare, education, agriculture AI.

opportunities.title: DSA & Competitive Programming Bootcamp
opportunities.description: Intensive 4-week bootcamp run by the Career Development Centre to prepare students for technical interviews at top product companies.

opportunities.title: Amazon ML Summer School 2026
opportunities.description: Amazon's selective ML Summer School offering courses on supervised learning, NLP, and computer vision with Amazon Scientists as instructors.
